31700-VIII.s: The bill sets the 2009 budget statements (begrotingsstaten) for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and for its baten-lastendiensten CFI and Nationaal Archief, in thousands of euros, with entry into force on 1 January 2009. The explanatory memorandum extract describes policy goals, budget envelopes and programme funding across primary, secondary, vocational and higher education, but contains no delegation of rule-making power of its own.
q: The budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2009 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2009 wordt vastgesteld.

32123-VIII.s: The bill sets the 2010 budget appropriations of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, in thousands of euros, including the baten-lastendiensten DUO and Nationaal Archief. The explanatory memorandum describes spending priorities across primary, secondary, vocational and higher education, with no new delegation of rule-making power.
q: Whereas, under Article 105 of the Constitution, the budget of the State's expenditure and receipts must be established by law
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat ingevolge artikel 105 van de Grondwet de begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het Rijk bij de wet moet worden vastgesteld

32222-VIII.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, adjusting expenditure, commitments and revenue across policy articles such as primary and secondary education, student finance and culture. It sets the amended budget in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from 1 December 2009, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2009
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2009

32360-XV.s: This bill amends the 2009 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and the budget statement for its executive agency, through a final supplementary budget (slotwet). It sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2009 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32609-VII.s: The bill amends the 2011 budget statements of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations and of its baten-lastendiensten (trading-fund services), including reallocations within the department. It also sets rounding in thousands of euros and an effective date tied to the budget year.
q: Amendment of the budget statements of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2011
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2011

32780-VII.s: This bill amends the 2011 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budget statement for its baten-lastendiensten (agencies), as adjusted in the Spring Memorandum. It mainly reallocates appropriations and loan-facility use, with the explanatory memorandum detailing migration-control and integration spending increases.
32780-VII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by the Spring Memorandum and actual or updated cost estimates for migration control, housing and agency financing.
q: The reason for the Rijksgebouwendienst to submit a 1st supplementary budget is the increase in use of the loan facility in 2011.
De aanleiding voor de Rijksgebouwendienst om een 1 e suppletoire begroting in te dienen is de verhoging van het beroep op de leenfaciliteit in 2011.

33480-XII.s: This bill amends the 2012 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment (XII) through a second supplementary budget (Najaarsnota), reallocating appropriations across policy and non-policy articles. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force on 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad appears later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment (XII) for the year 2012
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu (XII) voor het jaar 2012

33750-XII.s: The bill sets the 2014 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment and the budget statements for its agencies, in thousands of euros, including appropriations for waterways, roads, rail, aviation, shipping, climate, air and noise, and enforcement by the ILT. It takes effect 1 January 2014, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment for the year 2014 belonging to this act is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu voor het jaar 2014 wordt vastgesteld.

33930-XII.s: This bill is a supplementary budget law (Slotwet) that amends the 2013 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment and its agencies, reflecting technical and accounting adjustments. It makes no new delegations of rule-making power and shifts no power between the executive and the checks.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, accounting-related changes, or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

34016-(R2036).s: The bill adds Article 134a of the Dutch Criminal Code (terrorist offences) to the grounds on which Dutch nationality can be revoked under the Nationality Act. It applies only to offences committed after the law takes effect.
34016-(R2036).j: The memorandum justifies the extension by pointing to terrorist-related cases where no conviction under Article 134a was obtained, so the broader ground is needed to reach such conduct.
q: The bill extends the possibility of revoking Dutch nationality to cases involving assistance in carrying out or preparing terrorist activities.

Het voorstel van rijkswet bevat een uitbreiding van de mogelijkheid tot ontneming van het Nederlanderschap in gevallen waarin sprake is van hulp bij het plegen van terroristische activiteiten of bij de voorbereiding van dergelijke activiteiten.
p: Extends the grounds for revoking nationality to terrorist offences under Article 134a, widening executive discretion over citizens' nationality, though revocation remains subject to the existing procedure and courts.
Non-retroactivity clause prohibiting revocation for offences committed before the law's entry into force, protecting citizens against retroactive application.

parties: Asks how the revocation rule applies in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom and generally accepts that adequate remedies and legal protection exist.
Finally, these members are of the view that the bill fits within our democratic constitutional state and that sufficient legal remedies and legal protection are available.
Tot slot zijn deze leden van mening dat het wetsvoorstel past binnen onze democratische rechtsstaat en dat voldoende rechtsmiddelen en rechtsbescherming openstaan.
Doubts the measure's effectiveness and asks how the minister will weigh revocation criteria, whether revocation is always proportionate, and whether appeal to a judge is available.
It seems to the PvdA members that even where there is a final conviction under article 134a Sr., it need not always be opportune to revoke Dutch nationality.

Het komt de leden van de PvdA-fractie voor dat als er sprake is van een onherroepelijke veroordeling op basis van 134a Sr., het toch niet altijd opportuun hoeft te zijn om het Nederlanderschap in te trekken.
Insists that all relevant circumstances be weighed case by case and that revocation only apply where the vital interests of the state are seriously prejudiced, not merely to test statelessness.
These members explicitly ask the government to confirm that this will always (continue to) happen and that the intention is not merely to test whether someone becomes stateless.
Deze leden vragen de regering nadrukkelijk te beamen dat dit altijd zal (blijven) gebeuren en dat het niet de bedoeling is om slechts te toetsen of iemand staatloos wordt.
Asks how the bill relates to the Dijkhoff motion, whether the Rottmann ruling requires individual proportionality weighing, and why the bill was delayed.
The Court indicates that an individual balancing of interests must take place before nationality can be lost.
Door het Hof wordt aangegeven dat een individuele belangenafweging moet plaatsvinden alvorens de nationaliteit verloren kan gaan.
Asks why the advice of the ACVZ and Raad voor de rechtspraak was followed and whether the earlier draft's necessity and risk of wrongful loss were adequately justified.
Was it also considered to regard these advices as less decisive and therefore not to adopt them?
Is ook overwogen deze adviezen van minder doorslaggevend belang te achten en daarom niet over te nemen?
Welcomes that the advice of the ACVZ and Raad voor de rechtspraak was followed, but asks for conviction statistics and questions the effectiveness of the bill for current jihad travellers.
They note with satisfaction that the government has followed the advice of the ACVZ and the Raad voor de rechtspraak and has left article 15 RWN intact rather than amending it.
Zij constateren met tevredenheid dat de regering de adviezen van de ACVZ en de Raad voor de rechtspraak heeft opgevolgd en artikel 15 RWN in stand laat in plaats van te wijzigen.
Asks for evidence of effectiveness, conviction and dual-nationality numbers, criteria for revocation, and whether the bill will be evaluated.
The aforementioned members ask whether the government will evaluate the bill.
Voornoemde leden vragen of de regering het wetsvoorstel gaat evalueren.
Supports the bill but asks why the government omits modernising article 14 RWN on joining foreign military service and why statelessness is accepted in some cases but not others.
They support the bill but ask why the government takes a restrained position.
Zij steunen het wetsvoorstel, maar vragen waarom de regering een terughoudende opstelling kiest.

34085-VII.s: This bill amends the 2014 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budget statements of its agencies through a second supplementary budget. It sets budgets in thousands of euros and makes the amendments effective from 1 December 2014, with retroactive effect to 1 June 2014 if published later.

34200-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2014 budget (departmental and agency budget statements) of the Ministry of Economic Affairs by adjusting appropriations, expenditure and revenue, effective from the day after publication and retroactive to 31 December of the budget year. It is a supplementary budget law with no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: Departmental supplementary budget statement (final adjustment law) accompanying the Act of..........., Bulletin of Acts, Budget 2014 Economic Affairs
Departementale suppletoire begrotingsstaat (slotwet) behorende bij de Wet van..........., Stb.... Begroting 2014 Economische Zaken

35210-VIII.s: The bill amends the 2019 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the budget statement for agency DUO, adjusting appropriations, commitments and receipts by a first supplementary budget. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from 1 June 2019 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided ... The departmental budget statement for the year 2019 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2019 wordt gewijzigd

35300-VIII.s: This bill formally establishes the 2020 central government budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the Ministry for Primary and Secondary Education and Media, along with the budgets for the agencies DUO and Nationaal Archief. The explanatory memorandum describes budget reallocations, policy intensifications and cuts, and planning of policy evaluations, without delegating rule-making power.
q: The budget statement for the year 2020 accompanying this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2020 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no remarks on the draft 2020 budget bill for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) and advises submitting it to the House of Representatives. The government's nader rapport only proposes technical amendments to several budgets, including this one, without responding to any substantive objections.

35570-VII.s: This bill formally establishes the 2021 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (BZK) and the budget statement for its executive agencies, in thousands of euros. It sets the entry into force as 1 January of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2021 is established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2021 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no remarks on the 2021 budget bill for the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport confirms this and notes that only the Finance budget received a non-blank opinion, which is addressed in an annex.

35975-IV.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget statements for Kingdom Relations (IV) and the BES-fund (H) in a second supplementary budget, adjusting expenditure and commitment figures across policy articles. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and does not change the institutional position of parliament, courts or oversight bodies.
35975-IV.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to later-than-expected finalisation of country packages, reduced travel due to COVID-19, and exchange-rate effects on liquidity loans.
q: These funds became available because the country packages with the Caribbean countries and the action plan to strengthen border supervision were finalised later than expected.
Deze middelen zijn beschikbaar gekomen omdat de landspakketten met de Caribische landen en het plan van aanpak ter versterking van het grenstoezicht later zijn vastgesteld dan verwacht.

35975-VI.s: This bill amends the 2021 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security and the budget statement for its executing agencies, the second supplementary budget for 2021. It adjusts appropriations and receipts across policy articles such as police, legal aid, prisons and youth protection, and updates the agencies' operating and capital cash flows.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security for 2021 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd

36032-(R2162).s: The bill establishes by consensus rijkswet a College Aruba financieel toezicht that advises on and assesses Aruban budgets, borrowing and accounts against fiscal norms, with the Council of Ministers of the Kingdom able to issue binding directions, plus a Kroon appeal procedure. It continues financial oversight of Aruba agreed in the 2015 protocol and ties the college to fixed debt and deficit targets.
36032-(R2162).j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the long-term financial relationship with Nederland, the COVID-19 pandemic and the need for sustainable public finances, and says the college only signals and advises.
q: Financial oversight of Aruba's budget from the Kingdom is of great importance and remains necessary in the coming period.
Financieel toezicht op de begroting van Aruba vanuit het Koninkrijk is van groot belang en blijft de komende tijd noodzakelijk.
d: policy rules and directions for the college
amend fiscal norms and percentages by general administrative order
temporary deviation from fiscal norms in economic downturn
deviation from norms after natural disasters
binding directions (aanwijzingen) by Kingdom Council of Ministers
p: The Kingdom Council of Ministers can issue binding directions to the Aruban finance minister on budgets, borrowing and spending commitments, with only a Kroon appeal as remedy.
Decisions under the act are excluded from administrative court review, leaving only an appeal to the Crown.

parties: Asks what the added value of the Rijkswet is compared to the Landsverordening, whether the budget norms are realistic, and how the Rijksministerraad's override process and timing are arranged to avoid deadlock.
Can the government explain to what extent the stated goals and norms are truly realistic and achievable given the current economic situation and experience with the Landsverordening.

Kan de regering nader toelichten in hoeverre de gestelde doelen en normen ook echt realistisch en haalbaar zijn gelet op de huidige economische situatie en de reeds opgedane ervaringen met de Landsverordening.

Stresses that Aruba's autonomy must be preserved and doubts whether the budget norms remain realistic after COVID-19 and the war in Ukraine; asks about overlap with COHO and whether CAft approval of the budget infringes Aruba's parliamentary budget right.
These members ask to what extent the budget right of the Aruban parliament is being infringed.'
Deze leden vragen in hoeverre het budget recht van het parlement van Aruba wordt aangetast.

Asks what risks and consequences arise for Aruban citizens and the Netherlands if obligations are not met, what the ultimate powers of the Rijksministerraad are, and what options exist when an aanwijzing is not followed.
These members ask what (ultimate) options the Council of Ministers has to intervene and what the consequences would be for residents.
Deze leden vragen welke (ultieme) mogelijkheden er zijn voor de Rijksministerraad om in te grijpen en wat dan de gevolgen voor de inwoners zijn.

Calls for a more careful legislative process given that Kingdom legislation affects residents who lack direct influence over the Staten-Generaal, questions how Aruban parliament can initiate amendments, and asks about the criteria and review of kroonberoep and exceptional circumstances.
In what way can the Aruban parliament, these members ask, take initiatives when it judges that the content of the Rijkswet is no longer in Aruba's interest and should be amended?

Op welke wijze kan de volksvertegenwoordiging van Aruba, zo vragen deze leden, initiatieven nemen wanneer zij van oordeel zijn dat de inhoud van de Rijkswet niet meer in het belang van Aruba zou zijn en naar hun oordeel gewijzigd zou moeten worden?

Questions the unequal Aruban representation in the college appointment process, the strictness of the 10% GDP personnel cap given tourism vulnerability, and why review is by kroonberoep rather than an independent judge.
Why, regarding legal protection in article 26, was a kroonberoep chosen instead of an appeal to an independent judge, ask the members of the Partij voor de Dieren faction.
Waarom is in artikel 26 wat betreft de rechtsbescherming gekozen voor een kroonberoep in plaats van beroep op een onafhankelijke rechter, zo vragen de leden van de Partij voor de Dieren-fractie.
Asks whether the aim could have been reached in a less intrusive way given the existing relationships, and asks about the definition of the debt ratio and an imported deep recession.
They ask the government whether, given the existing relationships, the desired result could have been achieved jointly in a less intrusive way.
Zij vragen de regering of, gezien de bestaande verhoudingen, niet op een andere, minder ingrijpende wijze, in gezamenlijkheid tot het gewenste resultaat had kunnen worden gekomen.

Argues Aruba's finance minister should be able to give a response to the college's advice, as the current procedure does not reflect hoor en wederhoor, and asks whether reforms could stall during the override procedure.
That does not seem like hearing both sides and, according to the member of the Den Haan faction, does not fit an intended relationship of trust.
Dat lijkt niet op hoor en wederhoor en past volgens het lid van de fractie Den Haan niet in een beoogde samenwerkingsrelatie van vertrouwen.
The bill sidelines the Aruban parliament by sharply limiting its decision-making over policy and budget and eroding its controlling role.
The overwhelming majority is concerned because the draft Rijkswet sidelines the Aruban parliament.
De overgrote meerderheid is bezorgd, omdat de ontwerp rijkswet het parlement van Aruba buiten spel zetten.
Adopting such a bill through a Rijkswet creates a democratic deficit for Aruba and should be replaced by a landsverordening where possible.
The adoption, amendment and repeal of Rijkswetten, including consensus Rijkswetten, contain a democratic deficit toward Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten.
De totstandkoming, wijziging en intrekking van rijkswetten, waaronder consensusrijkswetten, bevatten een democratisch tekort jegens Aruba, Curaçao en Sint Maarten.
Fiscal targets may be unrealistic and hinder foreign investment, so a debt sustainability analysis should be required and the appointment rules amended to match the LAft.
According to MAS, the choice of ambitious budget targets to achieve sustainable public finances has not been sufficiently considered.
Volgens MAS is de keuze voor ambitieuze begrotingsdoelstellingen in het licht van de noodzaak om tot houdbare overheidsfinanciën te geraken, onvoldoende doordacht.
Supports the bill as a safeguard against future governments deviating from sound public finances, while asking about debt refinancing and education spending.

Adopting it will certainly give us peace of mind, knowing that proper financial management will be conducted and future governments will not be able to deviate from sound, sustainable public finances.

Het aannemen ervan zal ons zeker een goede nachtrust bezorgen, wetende dat een gepast financieel beheer gevoerd zal worden en toekomstige regeringen niet zullen kunnen afwijken van gezonde, duurzame overheidsfinanciën.
Warns that decisions imposed over citizens' heads without real participation polarize society and produce distrust, urging a genuine dialogue before reform.
Decisions taken over people's heads polarize society and encourage an every-man-for-himself attitude.
Besluiten over de hoofden van de mensen heen polariseren een samenleving en stimuleren het «ieder voor zich» gedrag.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the government's budget norms for Aruba's financial supervision bill (RAft) may not be realistic or feasible given the COVID-19 crisis, and raised points on minister addressees, the appeal procedure and retroactivity. The government's reply accepts or partly accepts most points, adds flexibility clauses and clarifications, but keeps the reconsideration procedure.
concerns: The budget norms may be unrealistic and unfeasible in the current post-COVID economic situation, and the Afdeling asked for reconsideration of article 15 with supporting analysis.
Unclear to whom directions (aanwijzingen) are addressed and appeal by the Aruban ministerraad would be inadmissible, so the addressee was changed to the Minister of Finance.
The option to ask the Raad van State to reconsider its draft decision on appeal may cause delay and uncertainty; the government kept this option with a changed procedure.
Unintended retroactive effect of several provisions referring to periods before entry into force, which were amended to avoid retroactivity.
Various drafting remarks on the bill and explanatory memorandum, including the independence clause, information duties and the liquidity planning, were largely incorporated.

36200-VIII.s: This is the 2023 budget bill (voorstel van wet) for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, setting the departmental expenditure statement and the agency budget statement for the year 2023 in thousands of euros. It also includes the explanatory memorandum covering education policy, funding instruments, and multi-year budget allocations for vocational education and research.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2023 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2023 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering reviewed the draft 2023 budget law for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) and raised no remarks, advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport informs the Crown that some budgets need amendments, referring to annexes, while the Afdeling's blanket advice on the budget laws is confirmed.

36360-XII.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (HXII) for 2022 and the budget statements of its agencies, as shown in the attached tables, in thousands of euros. It sets the entry into force of the Slotwet (closing budget act) and orders its publication in the Staatsblad.
q: We, Willem-Alexander, by the grace of God, King of the Netherlands, Prince of Orange-Nassau, etc. etc. etc.
Wij Willem-Alexander, bij de gratie Gods, Koning der Nederlanden, Prins van Oranje-Nassau, enz. enz. enz.

36410-XV.s: This is the 2024 budget bill (voorstel van wet) for the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (SZW), setting the departmental budget statement for 2024 in thousands of euros, with total expenditure around 58.3 billion euros. The explanatory memorandum describes the budget's policy articles on labour market, social assistance, disability, childcare, pensions and related programmes, without new delegations of rule-making power.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2024 belonging to this law is established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2024 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no remarks on the draft Budget Act 2024 for the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV), submitted with the Kabinetsmissive of 4 September 2023. The advisory letter recommends submitting the bill to the Tweede Kamer, and the text contains no government reply (nader rapport) addressing any points.

36470-VII.s: This bill amends the 2023 departmental budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budget for its executive agencies, through a second supplementary budget with net expenditure changes shown in thousands of euros. It also sets the effective date as the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 1 December 2023.
q: Article 1: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2023 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.

Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2023 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36560-VII.s: This bill is a slotwet (closing budget act) that amends the 2023 departmental budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budget of its agencies, mainly to record supplementary budgets and realised outcomes. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive powers, and no memorandum passages on delegation or oversight.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2023 is amended

Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2023 wordt gewijzigd

36740-VII.s: This is a supplementary budget law (Slotwet) that amends the 2024 departmental budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budget of its agencies, adjusting appropriations and realised figures. It contains only budgetary tables and does not delegate rule-making or shift powers between the executive and checks.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) and of the budget statement concerning the agencies of this ministry, all for the year 2024.

Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) en van de begrotingsstaat inzake de agentschappen van dit ministerie, alle voor het jaar 2024.
